source_text: Die sexto duplum; die septimo nihil. Sabbatum — requies Christi. Qui in sex diebus non laboravit, in septimo esurit.
pass_a_gloss: On-day sixth double; on-day seventh nothing. Sabbath — rest of-Christ. Who in six days not labored, on seventh hungers.
pass_b_english: On the sixth day a double portion; on the seventh [[none >> Bible:Exodus 16:26-27]]. Sabbath is Christ’s rest. Who will not work in the six days hungers on the seventh.
